messages.text: (a) “That is not true.” Arguing in public damages the hotel’s reputation.

(b) “We are so sorry to hear this, and it is not the experience we want for you. Please send us a DM with your booking details so we can make it right.” This is the ideal answer, empathy in public and a move to private.
(c) Ignoring it. Silence looks careless to everyone else reading.

heading_path: Online and Social Media Customer Service
